objective: GPU neural inference versus actual CPU SimLiquid/Aphros operators at large Cartesian grids;accuracy and time tradeoffs

scene_descriptions.many_drops: 256 disjoint disks,seeded positions and radii0.014..0.018;true full VOF fields

inputs: True11x11 stencils from each complete VOF field;3/5/7/9/11 are central crops. Only center fraction in[.002,.998] is evaluated;actual active counts and total N^2 both reported
models: All60 existing paired operator models and2 heads from the existing3x3 joint network;no retraining,geometry prior,geometric correction or fallback

native_cpu.parallel_adapter: persistent Python thread pool,one pinned thread per chunk;calls original thread-local C++ kernels;dispatch included;not a full simulator

modes: GPU resident input to completed GPU output
pinned CPU input through H2D,inference,D2H to completed CPU output
